On Fri, Sep 11, 2026 at 10:00 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Quick reminder — joining in a few.

All — I’ll lead the triage. Quick notes for the call so we’re aligned:
- If you can share a sample request shape or explain average token lengths, that’ll help me tailor batching advice.
- For caching: we support transient in-memory KV cache by default; persistent per-tenant cache is possible via our Dedicated config or via customer-managed Redis.
- Logs/export: we can push JSONL exports to an S3 bucket on a configured cadence; retention is configurable up to 90 days from the Console or via API.

I’ll capture the recording and meeting notes and drop them after the call. See you on Zoom.

— Dev Patel
